title: Beautiful and has remote!!
text: Beautiful and has remote!!. These are amazingly bright for being such a tiny seed light. The wiring is nice and thin, Yet I'm not worried about it breaking when I bend it to wrap around things. The distance in between each light is very nice, so there are no large gaps. My fav thing is having the remote . Soon as it gets dark, I just click on the remote and my lights go on without leaving my recliner and blanket lol
